messages:
maya: Quick request — can someone run a smoke + small regression bench for halcyon-9b on the dedicated pool? Need p50/p95/p99, tokens/s, and peak GPU mem. Also want a run with int8 quant if possible. Link to model: https://internal.models/halcyon-9b

ev an: on it. which input shapes should we use? typical chat or long-context?

maya: mostly chat (avg 48 tokens input, 64 tokens generation). also include a 1024 token long-context sweep (single-stream) to catch memory/kv issues.

evan: starting smoke now against a single c24-gpu node, config: `--batch-size 8 --max-gen 64 --profile-kv true`.

bench-bot: running job 34321... command:
```
./bench --model halcyon-9b --inputs "chat:48/64, long:1024/128" --batch 8 --quant none --trace kv,mem --out /tmp/bench-34321
```

bench-bot: smoke pass complete (smoke only) — summary:
- p50: 48ms/token
- p95: 95ms/token
- p99: 180ms/token
- throughput: 420 tokens/s (aggregate)
- peak GPU mem: 21.4GB
artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/bench-34321

linus: nice. did you see any KV cache blowups on the long-context run?

evan: long-context single-stream ran fine but saw steady GPU mem climb to ~26GB at 1024; KV allocations look correct but growth suggests we should bump oss-pool limit for this model on ded.

maya: note: Dedicated pool c24 has 32GB cards. 26GB peak is OK but we should test int8 to reduce mem. can you try an int8 pass with `--quant int8` and `--batch-size 16`?

evan: queued quant run (job 34322). will post numbers when done.

bench-bot: job 34322 complete (int8):
- p50: 54ms/token
- p95: 110ms/token
- p99: 220ms/token
- throughput: 610 tokens/s
- peak GPU mem: 13.8GB
notes: int8 increased latency slightly but throughput and mem are much better. no stability issues observed in 30m run. artifacts: https://artifacts.internal/bench-34322

sam: can we add these to the onboarding checklist and flag int8 as recommended for dedicated? also add a note to console docs about mem expectations for long-context.

maya: yes — i'll open a PR to the onboarding checklist with the numbers and links. also will add a follow-up to run a 6h soak with traffic mix next week.

evan: created a small perf note in the model catalog (internal) and added tags: dedicated-ok, int8-recommended, kv-check-needed. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/onnboarding/pull/782

linus: small action: we'll increase oss-pool soft cap by 2GB for halcyon-9b during canary. filing infra ticket.

maya: perfect — thanks everyone :rocket:

ev an: thanks — if nothing else, i'll mark this as smoke + int8-regression done and add to the release checklist.

bench-bot: thread artifacts archived to /runs/34321-34322.tar.gz

maya: closing out — follow-ups: 1) 6h soak next week (evan), 2) PR to checklist (maya), 3) infra ticket for pool cap (linus).
